W, B = map(int, input().split())

Ans = "No"
piano = "wbwbwwbwbwbw"
piano = piano * ((W + B) // len(piano) + 1)  # Repeat enough times

for i in range(len(piano) - (W + B) + 1):
    substring = piano[i:i + W + B]
    if substring.count('w') == W and substring.count('b') == B:
        Ans = "Yes"
